funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and a scheduled publication date within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (tiered funding). Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel and/or dedicated research time for projects in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or beginning a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to help students start or continue postgraduate study in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered undergraduate‑level or higher students (any nationality) researching eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel for students to examine historic works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) in person.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 (one‑year) – may be split over two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) beginning between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a master’s degree to bring new perspectives to British art research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK doctoral programme beginning between April 2027 and April 2028 (including international applicants).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research to expand understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) and above.
opportunities.summary: Funding for an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship (British School at Rome)

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium (exact figure not specified)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree (pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised).
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome to conduct advanced research on British‑Italian topics.
